svg.title: Taxi driver — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as taxi driver, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A front-view taxi has a clearly raised roof sign, sloping windscreen, low bonnet and separate wheels. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face.
